steps.title: Craft it
steps.say: Put 5 [planks](item:oak_planks) of the same wood in a U shape: 2 on top at the sides and 3 across the bottom.

steps.title: Put it on water
steps.say: Look at the water and use the boat to place it.

steps.title: Get in
steps.say: Use the boat to climb in. Use the move [buttons](item:oak_button) to paddle and turn.

steps.title: Bring a friend
steps.say: A boat has 2 seats. A friend or an animal can ride with you.

steps.title: Carry more
steps.say: Craft a boat with a [chest](item:chest) to carry your things. It only has 1 seat.

steps.title: Pick it up
steps.say: Hit the boat a few times to break it and get it back.
